title: Resurrection, Ascension, and Return of Christ
definition: The resurrection, ascension, and return of Christ are the truths that Jesus rose bodily from the dead, ascended to the Father's right hand, and will return in glory.
summary: Jesus is risen, exalted, reigning, and coming again.
christFocus: The risen Christ has conquered death, reigns as Lord, intercedes for His people, and will return to complete His kingdom.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Jesus did not remain in the grave. He rose bodily from the dead, confirming His identity, His victory over sin and death, and the truth of the Gospel. The resurrection is not an optional detail; it is central to Christian faith.

After His resurrection, Christ ascended to the Father's right hand. He reigns, intercedes for His people, and pours out the Spirit. His ascension is not absence but exaltation.

Christ will return in glory. The same Jesus who was crucified, raised, and exalted will come again to judge, restore, and openly reign. His return gives hope, urgency, endurance, and holy expectation.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Believers need more than forgiveness for the past; they need hope for death, strength for today, and confidence about the future. This doctrine anchors Christian hope in the living and reigning Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Live as one who serves a risen King. Let the resurrection strengthen your hope, the ascension strengthen your prayer, and Christ's return strengthen your faithfulness, holiness, and mission.
